ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota Daycare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of the Minnesota daycare fraud scandal, including the amounts involved and the parties affected.
questions: What is the total amount of money involved in the scandal?
Who are the main parties affected by the scandal?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can uncover the extent of the scandal and identify potential wrongdoing. This story has the potential to expose widespread fraud and hold those responsible accountable.
